moments.title: Strictly's New Era Begins
moments.blurb: The highly anticipated 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing kicks off with its launch show on Saturday, September 19, featuring new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: New Hosts, New Glitz
angles.copy: Glitterball season is almost here! Strictly Come Dancing returns September 19th with a fresh lineup of hosts: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe. Ready for the dancefloor drama? #StrictlyComeDancing

angles.name: Countdown to the Ballroom
angles.copy: Mark your calendars! The Strictly Come Dancing launch show is just over two weeks away (Sept 19). Who are you most excited to see take to the floor with the new presenting trio?

moments.title: Bake Off Tent Reopens
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off is set to return in late September 2026, with culinary icon Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as a new judge.

angles.name: New Judge, New Bakes
angles.copy: Get ready for soggy bottoms and Hollywood handshakes! The Great British Bake Off is back this month, and Nigella Lawson is joining the judging panel. What's your go-to comfort bake for watching?

angles.name: Bake Off Countdown
angles.copy: The tent is almost open! The Great British Bake Off returns to our screens later this September. We can't wait to see what Nigella Lawson brings to the judging table!

moments.title: Mark Ronson Turns 51
moments.blurb: Award-winning British-American DJ, songwriter, and producer Mark Ronson celebrates his 51st birthday on September 4, 2026.

angles.name: Uptown Funk Star
angles.copy: Happy 51st birthday to the legendary Mark Ronson! From 'Uptown Funk' to 'Valerie', his tracks always bring the good vibes. What's your favourite Ronson production?

angles.name: Production Genius
angles.copy: Celebrating Mark Ronson's 51st birthday on Friday! The man behind so many iconic hits, his influence on music is undeniable. What's his best beat?

moments.title: Queen Bey's 45th Birthday
moments.blurb: Global superstar Beyoncé Giselle Knowles-Carter turns 45 on September 4, 2026.

angles.name: Happy BeyDay
angles.copy: All hail Queen Bey! Beyoncé celebrates her 45th birthday this Friday. Which of her anthems makes you feel 'flawless'?

angles.name: Icon Turns 45
angles.copy: Forty-five years of fierce! Wishing a very happy birthday to the one and only Beyoncé on September 4th. From Destiny's Child to solo superstardom, she truly is iconic.

moments.title: Roger Waters Turns 83
moments.blurb: Pink Floyd co-founder, bassist, and principal lyricist Roger Waters celebrates his 83rd birthday on September 6, 2026.

angles.name: Pink Floyd Legend
angles.copy: On Monday, we're wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to Roger Waters! The visionary behind so much of Pink Floyd's iconic sound. What's your favourite Waters-penned track?

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to Pink Floyd's Roger Waters on September 6th. A true rock legend whose work continues to resonate.

moments.title: Gloria Gaynor Turns 83
moments.blurb: Disco legend and 'I Will Survive' singer Gloria Gaynor celebrates her 83rd birthday on September 7, 2026.

angles.name: Disco Queen
angles.copy: We will survive and celebrate! Happy 83rd birthday to the incredible Gloria Gaynor on Tuesday. Her anthems are timeless!

angles.name: I Will Survive Icon
angles.copy: Sending birthday wishes to the one and only Gloria Gaynor, turning 83 on September 7th! The voice behind some of disco's biggest hits.

moments.title: P!nk Celebrates 47
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning American singer and songwriter P!nk (Alecia Beth Moore) celebrates her 47th birthday on September 8, 2026.

angles.name: Raise Your Glass to P!nk
angles.copy: Raise a glass! P!nk turns 47 on Wednesday. An incredible artist with a voice like no other and unforgettable live shows. What's your favourite P!nk track?

angles.name: Pop-Rock Powerhouse
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 47th birthday to the phenomenal P!nk on September 8th. Her powerful anthems and rebellious spirit have defined an era!

moments.title: Wiz Khalifa Turns 39
moments.blurb: American rapper, singer, and songwriter Wiz Khalifa (Cameron Jibril Thomaz) celebrates his 39th birthday on September 8, 2026.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Wiz
angles.copy: Roll up, roll up! Wiz Khalifa celebrates his 39th birthday on Wednesday. The 'Black and Yellow' hitmaker always brings the chill vibes. What's your top Wiz track?

angles.name: Hip-Hop Star
angles.copy: Wishing a happy 39th birthday to Wiz Khalifa on September 8th. From chart-toppers to movie soundtracks, his impact is huge!

moments.title: Michael Bublé Turns 51
moments.blurb: Canadian-Italian crooner Michael Bublé, known for his smooth vocals and festive hits, celebrates his 51st birthday on September 9, 2026.

angles.name: King of Croon
angles.copy: Happy 51st birthday to the one and only Michael Bublé on Thursday! Time to put on some smooth tunes and celebrate the modern master of swing. What's your favourite Bublé ballad?

angles.name: Birthday Cheers
angles.copy: Wishing a fantastic 51st birthday to Michael Bublé this September 9th! His voice is pure gold. What song of his makes you swoon?
